title: Grateful Dead Live at Pittsburgh Civic Arena on 1973-09-24
lineage: Tascam DA-20mkII > SBLive! (48-44.1) > WAV > MKW Audio Compression Tool

ai_review.summary: Tasty Jerry guitar on a pristine vintage soundboard, with standout China Doll and The Greatest Story Ever Told.
ai_review.review: The recording captures the youthful energy of the September 1973 show on a clean, vintage soundboard that lets Jerry’s “yummy” tone shine. Reviewers single out the isolated “China Doll” and a beautiful rendition of “Greatest Story” as highlights, and praise the overall set list for its strength and flow.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are highly positive (average 4.7 stars) and consistently mention excellent soundboard quality and strong musical performance, giving a clear picture of a top‑tier show and recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, clear vintage board mix; no reported dropouts or muffiness – reviewers note the “old soundboards” sounding great.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Terrific set list praised for its cohesiveness; reviewers highlight the youthful vigor of the band and a strong overall pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “yummy sounding” with great tone.
